crossRefs.note: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

translations.web: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
translations.bsb: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
translations.kjv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
translations.asv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
